sloka: काकाः श्येनास्तथा गृध्रा नीचैः परिपतन्ति च ।शिवाश्चाप्यशिवा वाचः प्रवदन्ति महास्वनाः ।। ६.४१.२० ।।।।
transliteration: kākāḥ śyenāstathā gṛdhrā nīcaiḥ paripatanti ca ।śivāścāpyaśivā vācaḥ pravadanti mahāsvanāḥ ।। 6.41.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "The crows, hawks and also vultures are joining lowly animals like jackals and making loud noises which is inauspicious and not good."
